preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or have gained ownership)
Contract must have ETH balance (from accumulated fees or direct transfers)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setOperationsAddress() to set the operations address to a malicious contract you control. Then trigger swapBack() (via trading or forceSwapBack()) to make the contract send its ETH balance to your malicious address via the low-level call at line 563. The malicious contract should have a fallback/receive function that captures the ETH.
